w:r.w:t: The first three phase windows and their completed status are carried forward from PR1: scope/proposal W1-3, initial review/setup W3-6, and preliminary THR/IQR baselines with PR1 W6-10. Grey and green bars show planned and completed phase coverage, not a daily work log or exact task completion dates.

For PR2, the W11-15 phase covers model design, an initial OLS implementation, the common runner, real workloads, the concepts guide and report preparation. Its 100% status refers only to this initial PR2 scope. Demonstrating a predictive energy benefit remains unfinished. The initial implementation was brought forward from the proposal's T262 W4 target.

The template retains 24 week columns; only T261 W1-15 is plotted. As in PR1, later phases are T262 W1-7 (predictor refinement and PR3), W8-13 (experiments and demonstration), and W14-15 (final report and presentation). Their targets remain implementation/refinement W4, PR3 W7, experiments W10, demonstration W12-13, report W14 and presentation W15. Columns 16-24 are unused; later-term calendar dates are not invented. The technical work cutoff remains 15 November; later predictor experiments are excluded.
